content:
mara_sales: Looping folks in — Acme Finance needs a Private deployment POC. Main asks: preserve client IP for backend logs, acceptable TLS inspection posture, and we need an egress IP (static) for their firewall allowlist. They're also asking about pricing for reserved EIP + monthly connector. Timeline: POC start next Mon.
leo_se: Thanks — couple clarifying Qs: 1) Is traffic originating from customer on-prem or from their cloud VPC? 2) Do they require SNI preservation (no TLS inspect) or will they accept an outbound proxy that terminates TLS?
mara_sales: Primary flow is on-prem -> transit -> our Private deploy in their VPC. They prefer no MITM (SNI preserve) but can accept tunnel-based TLS inspect if we document controls.
devin_network: Options: 1) VPC peering/transit + NAT at our side => breaks client source IP (we NAT). 2) Interface endpoint (PrivateLink) => preserves client IP to the endpoint, but backend pods still see the endpoint IP unless we use proxy with X-Forwarded-For. 3) Sidecar/proxy in-customer-VPC forwarding to our service => preserves original src IP. Tradeoffs: complexity vs auditability.
devin_network: Quick snippet for the firewall allowlist they can give to their NetOps (example):
```
# Allow outbound from their NAT/edge to Redwood egress
allow tcp from 10.10.0.0/24 to 34.210.45.32/28 port 443 comment "redwood egress (example)"
# If using PrivateLink (interface endpoint) allow to endpoint subnets only
allow tcp from 10.10.0.0/24 to <iface-endpoint-ips> port 443
```
devin_network: Note: we will publish final egress IPs for the POC when we allocate reserved EIP. If they need client IP down to the application, we recommend running the lightweight forwarder in their VPC (we can provide container image + helm).
anya_security: From security Qs perspective we need to confirm: KMS integration (customer-managed?), TLS termination point, audit log export (CloudWatch/Splunk), and whether any PCI/PHI flows exist. Also add: does customer require HSM or bring-your-own-key?
mara_sales: Good call. Julie (Acme NetOps) said "no PHI, but finance PII may be present" — put BYOK on the Qs list.
leo_se: For pricing: reserved EIP + connector is typically a monthly SKU + per-GB egress after allowance. I'll pull standard POC pricing and attach to the quote. For now budgeting: reserved connector setup + first-month allocation cost.
mara_sales: Can you drop a one-pager we can forward? Goal: get firewall allowlist + sign-off by Thu so infra team can allocate IPs before Mon.
devin_network: I'll spin up a prereq doc: required subnets, security group example, and a helm chart for the forwarder. Will include a sample `iptables` snippet to preserve X-Forwarded-For.
devin_network: sample SG rules (customer-side):
```
Inbound to forwarder:
- TCP 443 from on-prem CIDR
Outbound from forwarder:
- TCP 443 to redwood-privatedeploy-ips/32
```
ops-bot: support-ticket #RI-31452 created: "Allocate reserved egress IP for Acme POC" — assignee: infra-team. ETA 48h.
anya_security: Also request: encryption-in-transit diagram + list of logs retained for 90/365 day windows for compliance review.
mara_sales: Action items: 1) @leo_se supply pricing one-pager by EOD tomorrow. 2) @devin_network publish prereq doc + SG/iptables examples. 3) @anya_security compile security checklist for Acme (BYOK, logs, SOC2 attest). 4) I'll coordinate with Julie for firewall sign-off.
leo_se: on it.
devin_network: will have docs and helm link by tomorrow lunchtime.
anya_security: I'll draft the checklist and upload to the shared drive.
mara_sales: Thanks team — I'll update the customer and confirm Thu review meeting. :thumbsup:
